details.releaseNotesExcerpt: <details open> server: visit parent slots before child slots (#30779) * server: visit parent slots before child slots A parent slot wakes its waiting child slots once it finishes the shared prompt prefix, while slots are visited in id order. When a child task lands on a lower slot id than its parent, the child is visited before the parent wakes it and waits an extra batch to process its suffix. Non-child slots are now visited before active child slots, so every child woken by its parent joins the same batch. * server: check systemone test events through test tags The systemone tests matched free-form debug messages, including the formatted f_keep value of the prompt cache. details.releaseNotesExcerpt: <details open> metal : fix GROUP_NORM for ne03 > 1 and non-contiguous inputs (#31852) The kernel_group_norm_f32 kernel and its host dispatch ignored the batch dimension (ne03) of the source tensor: only ngrp threadgroups were dispatched and each normalized the flat range [tgpig*gs, (tgpig+1)*gs) with gs = ne00*ne01*ceil(ne02/ngrp). For tensors with ne03 > 1, all but the first ne00*ne01*ne02 elements were left unwritten (exposed by the new GROUP_NORM test with ne=[3,1,1,65537], num_groups=1). Dispatch one threadgroup per (group, i03) pair (ngrp in x, ne03 in z, same work distribution as the Vulkan backend) and compute per-batch statistics, matching the CPU reference. Also clamp the group element count for the last group when ne02 is not divisible by ngrp and use int64_t indexing. The graph builds the expert FFN twice: on the device from the cache slots, where the misses left to the CPU read zero slots, and on the CPU from the host experts, where the experts computed on the device have id -1. details.releaseNotesExcerpt: <details open> llama, mtmd: follow the reference precision of ggml_prec_set_acc calls (#31851) * llama, mtmd: follow the reference precision of ggml_prec_set_acc calls Requests that the reference implementation does not keep in F32 move to GGML_PREC_BF16: the GLM4 family down and output projections, the MiMoVL vision matmuls and the Qwen3-TTS speaker encoder conv1d. The DeepSeek V4/V4.1 routers and the MiniMax-M3 indexer stay in F32 with a link to the reference line that computes them in F32. * ggml: handle GGML_PREC_BF16 the same way as GGML_PREC_F32 in backends Backends that reject GGML_PREC_F32 on the src1 of MUL_MAT_ID now also reject GGML_PREC_BF16 (CUDA, Hexagon, OpenCL, WebGPU, Vulkan), and backends that accept GGML_PREC_F32 for flash attention now also accept GGML_PREC_BF16 with the same F32 accumulation (CPU, SpaceMIT, ET). Vulkan keeps the F32 transfer between devices for both. The CUDA cuBLAS path already handles GGML_PREC_BF16 and is unchanged. * tests: cover GGML_PREC_BF16
